decision.interpretation: Large bold font (26.2pt) at top of page 1; serves as the primary document title introducing the report.
Large bold font (24.4pt) directly below main title; acts as the secondary title line completing the heading.
Medium bold font (20.6pt) below subtitle; specifies the fiscal years covered, forming the complete title block.
Bold font (12.7pt) on page 2; clearly labels and opens the Introduction section following it.
Bold font (13.2pt) on page 3; introduces the Abbreviations and Acronyms section.
Bold font (13.2pt) on page 4; introduces the Contents and Summary of Financial Data section.
